description: Create a DRAFT email in the user's connected Gmail mailbox, addressed to anyone ('draft an email to jane@acme.com about X'). Nothing is sent: the draft lands in Gmail's Drafts folder for the user to review, edit, and send themselves. Compose a specific subject and a plain-text body (no HTML or markdown) in the user's voice. Use this whenever the user wants an email written to someone else; send_email remains only for mailing the user their own address. Only works on mailboxes connected under a legacy modify grant; current connections are read-only and cannot create drafts; the tool says so if not.

account.description: Email address of the connected mailbox to create the draft in. Omit to use the first connected mailbox.

body.description: The plain-text body of the draft.

name: create_gmail_draft
title: Draft email
